name: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd
title: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd - 544029 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gandhar runs India plants at ~125% of 2-shift nameplate (4,58,853 KL vs 3,62,100 KL) with no committed capex plan yet; FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 5.53% with Q4 at 5.81%.

triggers.label: Capex plan deferred to 2-3 quarters
triggers.quote: we will shortly be drawing up our capex plans in the next 2 to 3 quarters

triggers.label: Pass-through on ~35-40% of contracts
triggers.quote: we have passed through contracts with about 35%, 40% of our customers

guidance.quote: Yes, it's around 6%, which we endeavor to maintain in the quarters to come.

guidance.value: historically ~10% a year; no numeric guidance
guidance.quote: Volume-wise also, we have historically had volume growth in the range of 10% also every year.

red_flags.label: Utilisation above nameplate; capex plan vague
red_flags.quote: in India, we are practically close to full capacity utilization

red_flags.label: Management evasive on margin drivers and forward guidance
red_flags.quote: So obviously, it will be a forward -looking statement, which we would like to avoid
